    The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament game between the Golden State Warriors and LA Clippers on Wednesday, April 15, is streamed exclusively on Amazon Prime Video. The game starts at 7:00 p.m. PT (10 p.m. ET) from the Intuit Dome. There is no traditional television broadcast; it is only available via the Prime Video app or website. 
    • Streaming Platform: Prime Video (exclusive).
    • Time: 7:00 p.m. PDT / 10:00 p.m. EDT.
    • Date: Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
    • Radio: 95.7 The Game, Warriors Radio Network, KEIB 1150 AM.
    • Watch Party: Thrive City (official Warriors watch party). 
    The game requires an Amazon Prime membership, though new users can use a free trial to access the Prime Video stream.
